title: Inheritable Signal Properties
description: Signal properties that follow the BIDS inheritance pattern: the dataset provides defaults and individual records can override them. Used in both dataset.signal_defaults and record.signal_properties.

power_line_frequency.description: Power line frequency in Hz (typically 50 or 60).

placement_scheme.description: Detailed electrode placement scheme from BIDS EEG sidecar (e.g., 'extended 10-10% system').
